summary: Explored hyperparameter adjustments focusing on learning rate schedules and optimizer settings. Found that warmdown_ratio=0.8 (vs baseline 0.5) slightly improves over aggressive warmdown=0.2, achieving 0.999534 vs baseline 0.997359. MATRIX_LR=0.06 proved optimal in peer results (0.996937), though my reproduction attempts did not complete recording. Key finding: gradient accumulation schedule warmdown is critical - aggressive changes degrade performance significantly.
